# BeanWorks for Offices

BeanWorks supplies freshly roasted coffee, brewing equipment and servicing to offices of every size. Our office programme takes care of the whole coffee routine, from choosing beans to keeping the machine descaled, so your team gets a good cup without anybody having to manage it.

## Our coffee

We roast in small batches every weekday and ship within forty eight hours of roasting. The office range includes a balanced house blend, a single origin rotating every month, a decaf and a certified fair trade organic blend. Beans are available whole or ground for filter brewing.

FACT: BeanWorks charges 14 dollars per kg for the house blend on office plans.
FACT: BeanWorks delivers every week on standard office plans.
FACT: BeanWorks leases a bean-to-cup machine for 65 dollars per month.

## Equipment

Our leased bean-to-cup machines grind and brew at the touch of a button and can make espresso, americano, cappuccino and latte. Leases run for twelve months and include installation, staff training and quarterly servicing. Offices that prefer to buy equipment outright can do so at a fixed price.

## Service and maintenance

If a machine breaks down, our technicians aim to visit within two working days. A loan machine is provided if a repair will take longer. Filters and cleaning tablets are included in the lease, and our team can set up automatic reordering so supplies never run out.

## Getting started

We usually recommend around one kilogram of coffee per twenty staff each week, depending on how much your team drinks. A free tasting session is available for new customers, where we bring several blends to the office so staff can choose their favourite before signing up.
